label_review.summary: Before freezing, 46 labels were edited: the edits were proposed with the help of Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), after a second Claude Opus 5.5 session critiqued the label definitions, and each one was approved by the repository owner. Afterwards, Google's gemini-3.1-pro-preview relabeled the edited messages blind as an independent check (see Independent relabeling). The change log is data/label-changes.md.
